title: Milk shortage.
bodyText: In the event of a shortage, the board shall require all milk produced within the milk shed first serve the needs of the consumers within the milk shed.
bodyHtml: [§157-34.5]  Milk shortage.  In the event of a shortage, the board shall require all milk produced within the milk shed first serve the needs of the consumers within the milk shed. [L 1988, c 25, §4]
